subject.title: Browser tool: 7 improvements from real-world automation field test

question: Which remaining browser-tool contract should be prioritized after selectors and batches: readiness/stale-state signaling, wait semantics, inspection/CAPTCHA diagnostics, or form-value verification?
rationale: The remaining proposals introduce different public tool behaviors and cannot be safely selected or combined from a single heterogeneous field report without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split and prioritize readiness/state
options.body: Create a focused current-main reproduction and define snapshot readiness or stale-state signaling before considering the other independent API additions.

options.title: Prioritize diagnostics
options.body: Design a bounded inspection/CAPTCHA signal surface if maintainer feedback identifies debugging blocked pages as the highest-value user path.

options.title: Archive remaining ideas separately
options.body: Close this umbrella only after linking individual accepted proposals to narrower tracked work items.

recommendation.title: Split and prioritize readiness/state
recommendation.body: Create a focused current-main reproduction and define snapshot readiness or stale-state signaling before considering the other independent API additions.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal for the already-landed selector and batch surface that defines the boundary of the remaining work.
